title: Read the repairs a workflow can keep
description: Read which steps of a saved workflow were repaired on its last runs and can be kept in the workflow. When a page changes, a run repairs a step whose recorded address reaches nothing and remembers the repair on this computer; the workflow itself is never rewritten by a run.
guidance: A repair that worked on the run that made it and on two further runs is offered here. steps 0 means there is nothing to keep. Call it after replaying a workflow whose run healed or repaired steps (a slower run, a repair handoff you answered), then keep the repairs with dsagent.workflow.repairs.answer. Read-only; no address or page text is returned.

workflowId.description: Opaque workflow identifier returned by dsagent.workflows.list, dsagent.wizard.save or a run.
